prose: In the 1982 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the United Democratic Front (UDF) emerged largest with 77 seats, against 63 for the LDF. Turnout was 73.6% of 13,111,851 electors.
By vote share, the UDF polled 48.28% and the LDF 47.3%, with the NDA on 2.75%. A total of 699 candidates contested the 140 seats.
The closest contest was Palluruthy, won by T. P. Peethambaran Master (Cong-S) over Eapen Varghese (KC-Joseph) by just 16 votes. The largest margin was E. Ahamed in Tanur (23,464 votes).
K. Karunakaran headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
